thread:
Jamie: Heads-up — scheduling a quiet-window slimshift tonight 23:00 UTC to pin router -> v3.2.1 and do a phased traffic tilt. Plan: warm cache -> canary 1% -> steady 10% -> fast 50% -> complete 100%. Need volunteers for checks and rollback readiness.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: window reserved 23:00-01:00 UTC. Suggested CLI: `deployctl pin router --model v3.2.1 --strategy slimshift --cohort canary=1` Dry-run ok.

Liam: I'll run warmup and watch latency dashboards.

Sara: I'll take logs/errbudget monitoring and prepare a fallback pin to v3.1.8-quant.

Miko: I'll help with load balancing checks and make sure LB drain timeout is set to 45s before shifting weights.

Jamie: Rollback criteria: absolute error-rate increase > 1% OR p95 regression > 150ms OR a host-level p99 spike > 1s. Wait 5m between steps. If drain issues appear, we abort and rollback.

devops-bot: DRY-RUN: route config validated. Note: add metadata tag `release:slimshift` and `warmup:true`. Release notes URL: https://releases.internal/6790

Liam: Kicking warmup: `internal-warmup --model v3.2.1 --samples 1200` logs: `warmup queued=1200 warmed=350/1200`. ETA ~2m.

Jamie: Launching canary (1%) in 30s. Ensure observability alerts are muted only for noise.

(devops-bot system): deployctl apply --dry-run 
CONFIG OK: weightmap canary=1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%

Liam: Canary live at 1%. Watching p95/p99 and error-rate.

Sara: Initial check p95=205ms baseline, error-rate +0.05% -> within tolerance. Proceeding to 10%.

Miko: LB drain started for host-az2-05 during ramp. Will monitor remaining open connections.

Liam: Moving to 10% now. Pausing 5m.

Sara: Noted a tail latency spike p99=980ms on host-az2-05 correlating with large GC pause. Related stacktrace shows V8::HeapNotify.

Miko: Marking host-az2-05 for evacuation. `routerctl drain host-az2-05` and bump LB weight-off.

Jamie: Pause further ramps. If another host shows same GC tail, we rollback immediately.

devops-bot: telemetry snapshot: p95 delta=+40ms, errors +0.3% — still under our threshold but host-level tail triggered drain.

Liam: Host drained. p99 dropped back to 420ms cluster-wide. Resuming ramp -> 50%.

Sara: Observability steady. No SLO alerts. Updating release notes: "warmup done; drained host-az2-05 due to GC tail; continued rollout."

Jamie: Push to 100% but keep a 15m watch. Oncall please keep rollback commands at hand.

oncall-kyla: Oncall ack. Staged rollback command: `deployctl unpin router --model v3.1.8-quant`. Also prepped router circuit breaker: `routerctl set-cb-threshold 1.5`.

Liam: 100% swap complete. Current metrics: p95=230ms, p99=460ms, errors +0.25%. No new errors.

Sara: I'll collect a brief post-rollout summary and add to release notes. We should also schedule a 6h pin retention per policy and reconvene if any regressions.

Jamie: Thanks team. Leave pin in place for 6h. If stable, we'll promote in the morning and then unpin after validation. Closing once notes and snippet are posted. :party_parrot:
